content.short: Tegro enables cross-chain token and NFT trades with a CEX-style orderbook in a DEX environment.
content.description: Tegro blends the ease of centralized exchanges with the openness of decentralized finance, delivering a trading experience that is both familiar and secure. Users enter an environment built around features like orderbooks and a broad marketplace for tokens and NFTs, making it easy to browse, compare, and execute trades. This fusion preserves transparency and control while offering intuitive tooling, empowering users to trade across multiple assets within a single, cohesive platform, all in line with the tenets of DeFi.
content.meta: Tegro blends the convenience of centralized exchanges with the transparency of decentralized ones. Discover Tegro and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
